one_line: Deterministic, crypto-verifiable substrate for recursive triad orchestration, claiming byte-identical reasoning across Node, browser and edge.

sections.challenges: Cross-runtime reproducibility is described as the hard part ('what works in Node silently diverges in the browser or a Python sidecar'); cryptographic provenance added latency until the chaining and tensor storage were optimised; licensing moved to BUSL-1.1 with a stated MIT conversion in 2030; the author calls the values-layer scoring question unresolved.
sections.how_we_built_it: TypeScript kernels in a pnpm monorepo, toolchain pinned (Node 22.22.2, pnpm 9.15.0) because cross-runtime byte identity dies on float formatting and JSON serialisation differences; rank-1 tensor storage to keep Merkle chaining affordable; a CUDA/ONNX acceleration layer via HTTP bridge with CPU fallbacks.
sections.inspiration: Discomfort that agent development 'relies on hope' — chained prompts plus retrieval plus祈祷 consistency. Proposes a substrate where every reasoning step replays byte-for-byte and is cryptographically audited, with stigmergy (ant-colony indirect coordination) as the memory model given Merkle-linked integrity.
sections.learned: Determinism across JavaScript, Python and edge runtimes is 'brutally difficult'; adding provenance changes development psychology from passing tests to building an immutable story of reasoning; eudaimonic scoring rewards trajectories that are high-alignment and high-utility.
sections.what_it_does: Described as a framework rather than an app: NOVA-NEO encoder for deterministic context-to-tensor conversion, Stigmergy v5 for pheromone-style memory with cosine recall, Holographic Etch as an append-only confidence ledger; a Universal Adapter Protocol under OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Gemini, Ollama and xAI; a Next.js 15 showcase site with a Three.js visual layer.
sections.what_next: Not stated as a product plan beyond continued adapter work.

testing: Claims Jest 96.6% coverage, Cypress, CodeQL and SBOM generation, plus 'reproducible benchmark tooling from day one' — none of it reachable, because the page links no repository.
